summary: Officers were sent at 7:07 p.m. to the 800 block of Olive Drive for a verbal disturbance.
Officers were sent at 7:14 p.m. to the 700 block of Planz Road for a domestic disturbance; a woman on the phone with her daughter heard what sounded like a struggle.
Officers were sent at 7:24 p.m. to the 900 block of 19th Street for a report of a suspicious person in an alley.
Fire crews and medics were sent at 7:25 p.m. to Edison Highway westbound at Fairfax Road north, where a vehicle hit a juvenile and one patient was down in the roadway.
Medics were sent at 8:09 p.m. to the Cracker Barrel on California Avenue for chest pain.
Officers were sent at 8:24 p.m. to Wilson and Wible roads for a welfare check on a man about 45 years old.
Medics were sent at 8:31 p.m. to a room at the Red Roof Inn on Oak Street for an ill patient.
Officers were sent at 8:32 p.m. to the Dollar Tree on the 2,500 block of South 8th Street for a burglary in progress; the man reported to be there was seen on camera in a black hooded sweatshirt.
Medics were sent at 9:18 p.m. to the 200 block of California Avenue for difficulty breathing.
Medics were sent at 9:42 p.m. to the 200 block of Howard Avenue for an overdose; a crew that checked a second address found no one there.

area: the 8100 block of East Brundage Lane
summary: Medics and officers were sent at 9:53 p.m. to the Burger King on the 8,100 block of East Brundage Lane, where a man was reported to be lying on the ground and not moving.
Officers were sent at 10:05 p.m. to the 1,900 block of Filson Street for a welfare check on a 12-year-old girl reported to be in the company of her stepfather.
Officers were told at 10:24 p.m. that about 30 vehicles were doing donuts in a parking lot on the 3,200 block of Ming Avenue.
Officers were sent at 10:28 p.m. to a home for a domestic disturbance; a man was reported to have threatened the caller and to have left on foot.

Deputies were sent at 10:43 p.m. to 7th Standard Road and Mayer Avenue for shots fired. A caller said two people were shooting and trying to shoot his brother. Deputies reported no injuries so far, said suspects might still be in the area with a victim hiding in a field nearby, asked for a drone, and at 11:01 p.m. began looking for shell casings.

Deputies were sent at 11:32 p.m. to the Edison Trailer Park on Edison Highway, where a 17-year-old was reported to have been hit with glass and had facial injuries; the man suspected of the assault left on foot.
Medics were sent at 12:02 a.m. to the back area of Buena Vista Lake, reached from Golf Course Road, for an allergic reaction with ineffective breathing.
Fire crews were sent at 12:48 a.m. to a working fire behind a home on the 5,500 block of Woodmere Drive, visible from the street.
Medics were sent at 1:10 a.m. to a unit on Parkwood Court for difficulty breathing.
Crews were sent at 1:27 a.m. to an outside fire at Olive Drive and Newson Drive; a later report from a passing truck placed it possibly behind a Chevron store near a known transient camp.

Crews were sent at 1:52 a.m. to a vehicle fire on Panama Road, where a Kia Soul was burning on the shoulder with no one around it; security at the property later reported someone awake and trying to pull the car out of a ditch.
Crews were sent at 2:03 a.m. to a commercial fire alarm at McKee Middle School on McKee Road.

area: the 4800 block of Jackson Ridge Avenue
summary: Medics were sent at 2:12 a.m. to the 4,800 block of Jackson Ridge Avenue for an ill patient.
Crews were sent at 2:44 a.m. to a vehicle fire on Muller Road just west of Tejon Highway.

agency: California Highway Patrol / Kern County Fire Department
summary: Fire crews were sent at 3:02 a.m. to a crash on the connector from westbound Highway 58 to southbound Highway 99; all occupants were out of the vehicle when the first crew arrived and the rest of the response was cancelled.

Officers were sent at 3:12 a.m. to the 2,200 block of Nelson Street for a suspicious person, described as a man in a black jacket and dark pants pushing a shopping cart alongside two other men with carts.
Officers were sent at 3:57 a.m. to the 300 block of Fairfax Road, where a caller said someone slapped her in the face and walked out of the residence.

Fire crews were sent at 3:58 a.m. to an apartment building on the 1,600 block of East 11th Street for smoke reported inside the structure; arriving crews found nothing showing from the one-story complex and went in to investigate.

Officers and fire crews were sent at 4:00 a.m. to the overpass at Olive Drive and Highway 99 for a report of someone who might jump from the rail; officers checked the bridges at Olive and Norris roads and reported no one on the overpass.
A white Dodge Ram and a gray Ford Fusion collided on Union Avenue about 4:16 a.m.; officers reported a woman bleeding at the scene and said the injuries were minor.
Medics were sent at 4:56 a.m. to the 4,000 block of 34th Street for a patient.
Officers were sent at 4:59 a.m. to a burglary in progress at a Toyota dealership, where camera video showed a man in a black hooded sweater on a bicycle on the left side of the property.
Traffic collision on Coulter Road injures one person.
Truck crash leaves vehicle in canal near Westchester.
Man found unresponsive after possible overdose.
Officers respond to keep the peace at Phoenix home.
Ongoing loud music complaint on Second Street.
Vehicle crash into fence on East California.
Domestic dispute reported on Fiesta Avenue.
Welfare check finds abandoned residence at Kern Seven and Rapid.
